title: Petra and the Undertow
author: Ansel Nystrom
blurb: Mara Sterling, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
